notes.title: HUGE UPDATE FOR ALPACA PARTY IS HERE!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]HUGE UPDATE FOR ALPACA PARTY IS HERE![/b] Dive into the thrilling new [b]Escape Mode[/b], explore [b]two folk-horror maps[/b], and hang out in our [b]all-new Social Hub[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 ESCAPE MODE: SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE[/b][/h3][p][i]Escape Mode[/i] is Alpaca Party’s brand-new [b]asymmetrical multiplayer experience[/b]! Your alpaca crew sails into a cursed village where an ancient evil—disguised as a "Wedding God"—lures villagers into deadly ghost-marriage rituals to devour souls. Trapped in this twisted dimension, some alpacas have already been corrupted...[/p][p][/p][p][b]HOW IT WORKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players split into [b]Survivors[/b] and [b]Watchers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Survivors[/b] must avoid capture until time runs out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Watchers[/b] must capture all Investigators before the clock ends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Caught Survivors turn into Watchers![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unique skills[/b] for every role. Use them wisely alongside map mechanics to survive—or hunt![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde56b8068d8b458e14e8147e6f11ea4f50375b8339e1c4c2483d2d35627fb737090d8abda4bb062eec3a156a98577f418d56954b6df18f877c8e036d20a2aab69e00feb0b9e4384b011951e131deb6f9c7a771c292a2df77fb2?tmpCode=615c35cd-cd3e-4526-bbcb-73ee101e845c"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🗺️ TWO NEW MAPS: NIGHTMARES COME ALIVE[/b][/h3][p][b]🎭 [i]The Opera House[/i][/b][/p][p]A blood-red cloth-wrapped tower in the wilderness, where a cursed wedding ritual unfolds. Sneak through bedrooms, backstage corridors, and the eerie theater itself to complete tasks and escape the Watchers’ grasp.[/p][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde56b8068d8b458e14e8147e6f11ea4f50375b8339e1c4c2483d2d35627fb737090d8abda4bb062eec3a156a98577f418d5b2662ec6b7f7f45ac3adc08c04fc0df025d7a29c9b90fa58decbf13f086aeb447c6463c7f2a65eeb?tmpCode=615c35cd-cd3e-4526-bbcb-73ee101e845c"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🏥 [i]The Hospital[/i][/b][/p][p]A lab of unspeakable experiments targeting alpacas. Dodge medical debris, evade dangling horrors from the ceiling, and expose the truth behind this facility. Hide, run, and fight to survive![/p][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde56b8068d8b458e14e8147e6f11ea4f50375b8339e1c4c2483d2d35627fb737090d8abda4bb062eec3a156a98577f418d59959845c80984aa23c81ebc623666819a0e4e64998cd9cff68225330e51850a0dcd3b58c0ee66469?tmpCode=615c35cd-cd3e-4526-bbcb-73ee101e845c"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎉 ALL-NEW SOCIAL HUB[/b][/h3][p]You asked, we delivered! Hang out with friends in our vibrant [b]Social Hub[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Access it via the [b]ship’s right side[/b] after logging in.[/p][/*][*][p]Play [b]mini-games[/b] scattered around the hub with your crew.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump straight into the [b]Item Shop[/b] or [b]start matchmade games[/b] from the hub![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde56b8068d8b458e14e8147e6f11ea4f50375b8339e1c4c2483d2d35627fb737090d8abda4bb062eec3a156a98577f418d5f5509946da1eaacc3e038385c824767cfef2916ffe98398e7ccd0b8a308fc17cc4d7db0a26355de6?tmpCode=615c35cd-cd3e-4526-bbcb-73ee101e845c"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Party with the Alpacas! Follow us for the fun.[/b] 🦙💃 [/p][p][b]DISCORD:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/vTwZ2pvMva"]https://discord.gg/vTwZ2pvMva[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343614/9ce394e9bcf93a634643b0d905bc3f870bd5ccd2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde56b8068d8b458e14e8147e6f11ea4f50375b8339e1c4c2483d2d35627fb737090d8abda4bb062eec3a156a98577f418d5661afec846574ea1fff739252d673298462d8423772b18dad122883daa9559fafe2b7b6ed051f461?tmpCode=615c35cd-cd3e-4526-bbcb-73ee101e845c"][/img][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Dive into the thrilling new Escape Mode, explore two folk-horror maps, and hang out in our all-new Social Hub!
Escape Mode is Alpaca Party’s brand-new asymmetrical multiplayer experience!
Players split into Survivors and Watchers.
Survivors must avoid capture until time runs out.
Watchers must capture all Investigators before the clock ends.
Unique skills for every role. Use them wisely alongside map mechanics to survive—or hunt!

A blood-red cloth-wrapped tower in the wilderness, where a cursed wedding ritual unfolds. Sneak through bedrooms, backstage corridors, and the eerie theater itself to complete tasks and escape the Watchers’ grasp.
A lab of unspeakable experiments targeting alpacas. Dodge medical debris, evade dangling horrors from the ceiling, and expose the truth behind this facility. Hide, run, and fight to survive!
You asked, we delivered! Hang out with friends in our vibrant Social Hub:
Access it via the ship’s right side after logging in.
Play mini-games scattered around the hub with your crew.
Jump straight into the Item Shop or start matchmade games from the hub!
